sanskrit_verse:
बहुधार्थभृतः प्रोक्तस् तथा भागभृतोSपरः ।
हीनमध्योत्तमत्वं च सर्वेषामेव चोदितम् ॥
transliteration: bahudhārthabhṛtaḥ proktas tathā bhāgabhṛto 'paraḥ / hīnamadhyottamatvaṃ ca sarveṣām eva coditam //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who sustains multiple purposes is declared as such; likewise, one who bears a share is distinct. Inferiority, mediocrity, and superiority are enjoined for all beings according to their capacity and alignment with Dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from alignment with Dharma, not position alone
Causation is determined by conscious capacity and role-bearing
Capacity-based responsibility assigns duty proportionally to spiritual and functional maturity
Restoration logic operates through realignment with one's true role and purpose
Consciousness alignment determines the gradation of function and participation in societal order
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity bears multiple roles THEN assign designation based on primary dharma-sustaining function
IF entity holds shared responsibility THEN define boundaries by svadharma alignment
IF entity exhibits low-medium-high capacity THEN allocate duties accordingly without hierarchy of worth
IF misalignment detected THEN initiate reorientation protocol toward svadharma resonance
IF systemic disharmony observed THEN recalibrate role assignments based on consciousness-readiness metrics
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, this verse establishes that legal identity and authority derive not from inherited status or formal title, but from demonstrated alignment with sustaining Dharma. Hierarchical distinctions must reflect inner capacity and outer serviceability, not social convention or coercive power. The court must assess parties based on their actual bearing of purpose, ensuring roles are assigned to maximize harmonious functioning.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that differentiation among individuals stems from svabhāva and samskāra, not arbitrary imposition. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how each being naturally manifests inferior, medium, or superior fitness for specific functions. Responsibility follows recognition of one’s inherent suitability. There is no punitive value in categorization—only precise placement for optimal unfoldment and collective uplift.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma discovery process through introspective inquiry and guided meditation
Assign provisional roles aligned with current consciousness-level until higher integration achieved
Establish mentorship frameworks to elevate lower-capacity entities into greater functionality
Reintegrate fragmented identities through ritual affirmation of unique dharmic contribution
Conduct periodic review cycles to reassess and realign individual roles with evolving consciousness
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. This verse upholds Dharma through capacity-conscious assignment, restoring harmony via role-rightness. Justice flows from awareness, not force. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
